about_the_game:
・Exciting Skeleton World

A vast Skeleton World──Explore the ever-changing open scenes and encounter different types of skeleton enemies.

Feel the joy of exploring new discoveries and the sense of accomplishment when conquering powerful enemies. Rich content is waiting for you to experience.

・Collect weapons and equipment from defeated enemies

Each time you defeat an enemy, you can gain the enemy's soul power, and it is more likely to drop the enemy's weapons and equipment──

Choose a weapon that suits you, wear stronger equipment to challenge stronger enemies.

・Group drama in the Skeleton World

In the cold and broken Skeleton World, fragmented but colorful stories are staged one by one.

Note: This version is a free DOMO version, which includes the first map open area. The enemies, drops and game characters encountered in this area are the same as the official version, including 3 initial bosses. After clearing the level, subsequent enemies and areas need to be unlocked by purchasing the official version.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 0r AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Bone Souls is an action RPG game set in a dark fantasy world. Enter a vast scene, challenge difficult and dangerous situations, and enjoy the sense of accomplishment when overcoming difficulties. The characters you meet on the journey and the stories that happen to the players are not to be missed.
